## Job description

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at www.digicert.com

**Job summary**

DigiCert AI Trust is building the trust layer for the AI agent ecosystem. It covers identity, governance, and security for every kind of agent: SaaS agents, MCP servers, agent registries, and agents running in customer clouds. AI Trust Manager is the console customers use to discover, onboard, govern, and monitor all of these from one place. We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to help build it and shape where the UI goes next.

**What you will do**

- Build features across the console, such as agent and MCP server discovery, agent registries, policies, credentials, audit logs, and violations.
- Develop fast, data-rich interfaces in React and TypeScript, including large tables, multi-step workflows, and real-time status updates.
- Work with backend engineers to define APIs and deliver features end to end.
- Maintain and extend the shared design system so the product stays consistent and accessible.
- Make sure features are well tested, perform well, and follow secure frontend practices.
- Mentor other engineers and raise the bar through code reviews.

**What you will have**

- 6+ years of frontend experience, including 3+ years building production apps with React and TypeScript.
- Strong command of modern React patterns, server-state management (e.g., TanStack Query), and Tailwind CSS.
- Experience building complex enterprise or B2B SaaS applications.
- Solid testing habits (Vitest/Jest, Testing Library, Playwright) and an understanding of web security and authentication (OAuth/OIDC).
- Clear communication and comfort working across teams.
